issues.description: Method parameter type inconsistency for addGuestStudents: the problem statement text (problem_statement.md) instructs to "Implement a addGuestStudents(String) method" (lines 49-50), while the UML diagram in the same problem statement (class Lecture, line 73) and the reference implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java, line 90) declare addGuestStudents(int). This mismatch (String vs int) will confuse students about which parameter type to implement and can lead to implementations that don't match the intended API or the tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter type consistent across the exercise materials. Change the textual task in problem_statement.md (around lines 49-50) from addGuestStudents(String) to addGuestStudents(int) to match the UML and the reference implementation. Verify and update any other occurrences (task list, examples) so all artifacts consistently specify addGuestStudents(int).
